issues.legal_issue: A writ petition seeking consideration of a settlement request should not be rejected solely because related writ petitions challenging an order concerning the sale are pending.
material_facts: A borrower filed a writ petition seeking a direction for the bank to process its settlement application.
The bank and the auction purchaser had filed separate pending writ petitions challenging an order that set aside the auction sale.
The High Court dismissed the borrower's writ petition mainly because the bank's challenge was pending, without deciding the merits of the settlement request.
issues.conclusion: The High Court's dismissal was set aside, and the writ petition was restored for fresh consideration after the related writ petitions were disposed of. The merits and all available contentions were left open.
issues.legal_principle: A pending related challenge does not, by itself, justify rejecting a writ petition that may require consideration after that challenge is resolved. Consideration of the settlement-request writ would arise only if the related writ petitions were dismissed, so it was to be restored and considered after those petitions were disposed of. The Court did not decide the merits or the maintainability of the revision under Section 154 of the Maharashtra Cooperative Societies Act read with Rule 107 of the Maharashtra Cooperative Societies Rules, 1961. No earlier cases were relied on.

predicates.appeal_from_writ_dismissal: A party appealed after a court dismissed its writ petition.
predicates.underlying_writ_seeks_settlement_request: The dismissed writ petition sought consideration of a borrower's settlement request by a lender.
predicates.underlying_writ_rejected_due_to_pending_: The court dismissed the writ petition mainly because related challenges were pending.
predicates.related_challenges_concern_order_affecti: The related challenges concerned an order affecting a sale of assets used to secure a loan.

issues.definition: When an appeal follows dismissal of a settlement-request writ mainly because related challenges concerning an order affecting a sale are pending, the writ is restored for consideration after those challenges are disposed of.
